reproducibility_gaps: No repository license, README, citation metadata or formal dependency manifest was identified.
The SDSS dataset is downloaded from Kaggle at runtime and no reusable dataset payload is bundled.
GalaxyMNIST setup clones an unpinned external repository and loads an external TensorFlow Datasets package at runtime.
Inline installation covers only three imported packages and pins no versions.
Scikit-learn random states are set, but TensorFlow training and NumPy sample selection are not seeded.
Exact hardware/runtime requirements and numerical acceptance thresholds are not reported.
notes: R1: a source notebook and substantial workflow detail exist, but incomplete unpinned installation and runtime network dependencies block R2.
